text: olivia: Quick q — for active/active EU/US, where enforce 'data residency'? proxy or control plane? sam: both. proxy = user-facing low-latency block; control plane = source of truth. anya: Edge enforcement is primary. If tenant has residency-preference header, treat as soft hint? :thinking: rui: RFC defined modes: strict, soft, mirrored. proxy checks header+policy -> route-local / attach-proof / reject. marco: Need escape hatch for Dedicated/HSM customers: return 403 + audit id. olivia: Two followups: 1) what does proxy send to control plane as proof? 2) avoid split-brain when proxies disagree during failover? sam: Emit signed assertion header X-Proxy-Residency-Assertion: base64({tenant,policy_v,decision,ts,nonce}) signed with proxy short-lived key. anya: For split-brain, use control-plane write-leases with TTL+version; control plane arbitrates highest version. rui: Need lease API: AcquireWriteLease(tenant,region,expected_version) -> {lease_id,version,ttl}. prototype in runtime. marco: Latency concern on cold writes. Proposal: hybrid: default optimistic local commit + background registration; strict tenants = sync lease. olivia: Good — operator contract change. infra-bot: deploy-notice: residency-lease-api v0.3 -> staging-eu-2 (2026.03.18-78). sam: Keep assertion header compact; validate signature when forwarded. anya: Policy cache invalidation via pubsub TTL=5s to avoid stale reads; add metric policy-miss-rate. rui: agree. marco: Add diagnostic header X-Residency-Decision-Trace [policy_v,lease_version,decision,trace_id]. olivia: Action items: update operator contract, spec assertion payload/signing, draft lease API proto, add cache invalidation TTL+metrics. sam: I'll sketch signing + rotation cadence. anya: I'll draft lease proto + revoke/reclaim errors. rui: I'll prototype proxy hook for assertions + audit. marco: I'll coordinate with legal for strict-tenant list. olivia: I'll write RFC-followup and link runbook. sam: Any need for HSM-signed assertions? anya: Offer optional HSM/KMS attestation for enterprise; default proxy key ok. infra-bot: reminder: maintenance eu-proxies-2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC — assertions may be delayed. olivia: noted; will add maintenance note to operator checklist. sam: +1, thanks everyone.
